# WP9 meaning-review snapshot

English source: merged master `95f5936800ca2358da0c2afa0a1d6286ac022691`. The four guides and quiet disclosure were compared sentence by sentence with English by AI for each locale below. These are machine or AI translation drafts; none has native review or device certification. The review records under the project PM workspace distinguish independent comparisons from self-review. Estonian awaits Patric’s native review before PR readiness.

Independent AI guide comparisons: `ar`, `de`, `es-rES`, `es-rUS`, `fr`, `he`, `hr`, `hu`, `in`, `it`, `ja`, `pl`, `pt-rBR`, `ru-rRU`, `zh`. Guide self-comparisons: `et`, `sv`, `tr`, `uk`. Disclosure comparisons were separate AI checks for the existing 18 locales; Estonian disclosure was self-checked. Hungarian disclosure contains the corrected “remain snoozed” wording.

Twenty independently reviewed `ar`/`he`/`hr`/`hu`/`in` guide hashes were compared against the final resource text and matched their original or focused-recheck records. The earlier `es-rES`/`es-rUS`/`fr`/`it` and other review records did not provide per-text hashes; two Spanish label corrections were applied after review and checked against the source label map. This snapshot freezes the final text; it does not retroactively establish a missing review hash.

For each value below, parse the resource XML, take its text, decode Android escaped apostrophes and double quotes (`\'` and `\"`) to their literal characters, retain literal Android `\n` sequences, encode UTF-8 and calculate SHA-256. Changes to source, candidate or displayed labels require a fresh comparison. Counts, UI label equivalence and semantic correctness are not proved by hashes.
